builtBy: Research by hand on 2026-11-13: the clubs’ own websites (read by script, in Chromium where the links are rendered by script); for the teams, the schools’, districts’ and athletics departments’ sites and the programs’ own sites, student papers, the owner’s own reports and search results. Handles not linked from a page of the owner’s were opened in Chromium to check the profile is the team’s.
notes: Links, not sources: no fact on the site is read from an account (README "Instagram accounts", DATA-SOURCES §1.10).

A team’s account is its field hockey program’s own (level varsity), or its JV team’s own (level jv); never the school’s or the athletics department’s account for every sport, a booster club’s, a club team’s or a player’s.
No record means no account we could find and check on the day, not that there is none.
